description: Research watchdog wrapper using GPT Researcher with Ollama inference, nomic embeddings, SearXNG search, Playwright browsing, Trafilatura or Crawl4AI extraction, and optional Qdrant memory.

architecture_profile.summary: Linux deep-research wrapper; it researches topics but is not a general device-control agent.
capabilities: Produce source-backed research reports using the configured search, browser, extraction, and inference services.
unavailable_actions: Cannot perform arbitrary shell, filesystem, device-control, or physical actions.
observable_state: Observes public or reachable web content returned by its configured research stack.
required_dependencies: Requires Ollama, an embedding model, SearXNG, browser support, and the selected extraction engine.
privilege_boundaries: Uses only the permissions of its service account and configured network services.
physical_constraints: Has no physical sensors or actuators.
known_failure_modes: Research quality degrades when search, model, browser, or extraction dependencies are unavailable.
uncertainty: Cannot guarantee source completeness, freshness, accessibility, or factual correctness.

tools.name: research
tools.documentation: Research, Description: Runs a GPT Researcher deep-research task, Command - research:TOPIC, Example - research:Compare local-first AI research stacks

questions.name: GPT_RESEARCHER_LLM_MODEL
questions.label: Ollama LLM model
questions.help: Model tag to pull/use through Ollama. The wrapper maps it to FAST_LLM, SMART_LLM, and STRATEGIC_LLM.

questions.name: GPT_RESEARCHER_QDRANT_URL
questions.label: Qdrant URL
questions.help: Optional. Set when a long-running research worker should remember sources in Qdrant.
